latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Claw Asset & Privacy Guardian.

- Provides local scanning for digital asset and privacy protection, including credential leaks, account security, privacy settings, and asset monitoring.
- Generates anonymous, non-sensitive reports with customizable sensitivity and scan targets.
- Features modular command-line and Python interfaces for scanning, monitoring, and reporting.
- Designed for strong privacy: all data processing and storage are local, with anonymized outputs.
- Commercial model includes free, pro, and enterprise versions supporting individuals, developers, teams, and enterprises.
